pb_01.EN: Rohit Sharma drives for FOUR (+4 runs, +1 boundary bonus = +5 pts).
pb_01.HI: Rohit Sharma ne cover drive par chauka jada (+5 pts).

pb_02.EN: Another boundary for Rohit Sharma (+4 runs, +1 bonus = +5 pts).
pb_02.HI: Rohit Sharma ka ek aur chauka (+5 pts mile).

pb_03.EN: Rohit Sharma caught by Ravindra Jadeja (+8 pts catch for Jadeja). Tushar gets +25 pts wicket.
pb_03.HI: Rohit Sharma out huye, Ravindra Jadeja ne catch liya (+8 pts). Tushar ko mile +25 pts.

pb_04.EN: Suryakumar Yadav scoops for SIX! (6 + 2 bonus = 8 base). 1.5x Vice-Captain = +12 pts!
pb_04.HI: Suryakumar Yadav ne fine leg par chhakka mara! 1.5x Vice-Captain ke sath mile +12 pts!

pb_05.EN: Suryakumar Yadav slices for FOUR (4 + 1 bonus = 5 base). 1.5x VC = +7.5 pts!
pb_05.HI: Suryakumar Yadav ne chauka mara. 1.5x Vice-Captain multiplier ke sath jude +7.5 pts!

pb_06.EN: Huge SIX by Suryakumar Yadav over midwicket! (8 base x 1.5 VC = +12 pts)!
pb_06.HI: Suryakumar Yadav ka zabardast chhakka! (8 base x 1.5 VC = +12 pts)!

pb_07.EN: Lofted FOUR over cover by SKY! (5 base x 1.5 VC = +7.5 pts)!
pb_07.HI: SKY ne extra cover ke upar se chauka mara! (5 base x 1.5 VC = +7.5 pts)!

pb_08.EN: SKY crosses 30 runs with a SIX (+4 milestone bonus, x 1.5 VC = +6 pts)!
pb_08.HI: SKY ne chhakke ke sath 30 runs pure kiye (+4 milestone bonus, x 1.5 VC = +6 pts)!

pb_09.EN: Driven through point for FOUR by SKY (5 base x 1.5 VC = +7.5 pts)!
pb_09.HI: SKY ne point par chauka mara (5 base x 1.5 VC = +7.5 pts)!

pb_10.EN: Suryakumar Yadav smashes his FIFTY off 17 balls! Milestone upgrades to 50 (+8 pts x 1.5 VC = +12 pts)!
pb_10.HI: Suryakumar Yadav ne 17 balls me 50 pura kiya! Milestone bonus upgrade ho kar +12 pts mila!

pb_11.EN: SKY crosses 10 balls with strike rate > 250, claiming the maximum +6 Strike Rate Bonus (x 1.5 VC = +9 pts)!
pb_11.HI: SKY ne 10 se jyada balls me 250+ strike rate maintain kiya, jisse +6 SR Bonus x 1.5 VC = +9 pts mile!
